headline: Overseas workers' remittances to Pakistan rose 14% year-on-year to $3.89 billion in October 2026, with Saudi Arabia the largest source at $982 million, the State Bank of Pakistan said on Tuesday.

card.desc: Saudi Arabia se sab se zyada $982 million aaye.

caption:
Overseas Pakistaniyon ne October mein $3.89 billion ghar bheje!
Business Recorder ke mutabiq State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) ne Tuesday ko bataya ke October 2026 mein bahar se aane wali raqam (remittances) $3.89 billion rahi. Yeh pichle saal October ke $3.42 billion se 14% zyada hai. Sab se zyada paisay Saudi Arabia se $982 million aaye, phir UAE se $816 million.
Kya aap ke ghar ka bhi koi bahar kaam karta hai? Comment mein batayein 👇
